per_question.question: Does NC Medicaid cover chiropractic services under Clinical Coverage Policy 5B?
per_question.agent_answer:
No. Clinical Coverage Policy 5B does **not** cover chiropractic services as such; Policy 5B covers **orthotics and prosthetics** when the policy’s coverage criteria are met. The covered items must be medically necessary orthotic or prosthetic devices, and they must be ordered by a physician, physician assistant, or nurse practitioner—not simply provided as chiropractic treatment. [Orthotics & Prosthetics](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/5b-orthotics-prosthetics/download?attachment)

Why:

- **Scope of covered services:** Policy 5B covers a “procedure, product, or service” only when it meets the general coverage criteria in § 3.1 and the specific orthotics/prosthetics criteria in § 3.2.1. Section 3.2.1 specifically describes coverage for **orthotic devices** and **prosthetic devices** and requires that they be ordered by a physician, PA, or NP and be medically necessary. [Orthotics & Prosthetics](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/5b-orthotics-prosthetics/download?attachment)
- **Not covered under 5B:** Section 4.1 says Medicaid does not cover a service if the beneficiary does not meet Section 3.0 criteria, and § 4.2/4.2.1 lists additional non-covered situations. So if the request is for **chiropractic services** rather than a covered orthotic or prosthetic device meeting 5B criteria, it is not covered under this policy. [Orthotics & Prosthetics](https://medicaid.ncdhhs.gov/5b-orthotics-prosthetics/download?attachment)

I also checked for amendments to Policy 5B, and the authoritative current document is still **Clinical Coverage Policy 5B, Orthotics & Prosthetics**.  

If you want, I can also check whether **chiropractic services are covered under any other NC Medicaid policy** rather than under 5B.
